time.desc: The company updated its plan to maintain its listing status, expressing its belief that it can submit delayed annual reports and quarterly reports before regulatory cutoffs. At the same time, it lowered its revenue forecast for the current period and forecasted its revenue target for the next year.

The company submitted overdue annual reports and quarterly reports to the regulatory authorities, re-complied with the exchange's listing application requirements, and the delisting crisis was officially closed.
The company appoints new independent directors and promotes general counsel to strengthen corporate governance structure

The company released quarterly unaudited financial results, with revenue declining quarter-on-quarter, gross profit margin and net profit falling sharply, and confirming that all pending financial statement submissions have been completed

After the company announced its annual financial report, its stock price plummeted, its revenue and earnings per share fell short of market expectations, its gross profit margin continued to decline, and its full-year revenue forecast was significantly reduced.

The company disclosed in its annual documents that there were major deficiencies in the internal control of financial reporting and that it failed to operate effectively. Corrective measures have been initiated but there is no guarantee that they will be completely resolved.

The company's co-founder and CEO was arrested and faces multiple federal criminal charges for allegedly illegally smuggling high-end chips to specific countries through a network of affiliated companies, bypassing export control regulations.
Company board member resigns as director, company appoints acting chief compliance officer, separates compliance function from financial responsibilities
The company's two independent directors launched an independent investigation to verify employees' suspected smuggling of chips to specific countries.

The company announced the appointment of a lead independent director to lead the internal investigation. The chairman of the audit committee will assist in the advancement, hire an independent consultant and coordinate with the audit agency to report the results.

The company disclosed its fiscal year results. Revenue doubled, net profit increased significantly year-on-year, but gross profit margin declined, confirming that the report does not need to be restated.

The market questioned that many of the company's senior executives accurately reduced their holdings to cash out during the delay in the annual report and the stock price changes, and the stock price subsequently plummeted.
After Company A submitted its overdue financial report and lifted the risk of delisting, its stock price soared by more than 24% in after-hours trading.
Company A disclosed that its gross profit margin for the fiscal year fell from approximately 18% to approximately 13.8%, putting the quality of earnings under pressure.

After Company A completed the submission of all overdue documents, its stock price soared by more than 23% after the market closed. It plummeted by nearly 12% during the session as the delisting cutoff approached.
The CEO of Company A said that some customers have postponed platform decisions and deferred related orders to subsequent quarters.

Company A gave guidance on the range of net sales for the next quarter and stated that it has implemented the recommendations of the special committee and complied with all exchange reporting requirements.
